_doc: Loose cultivators of the north (loose-north) Effect engine records (world-depth Stage 6; ADR-0009). Merged into assets/data/combat_effects.json under source world-depth:loose-north.

Flame Leans.rule: Old Bronze Lamp (ln-old-bronze-lamp): in a sealed or buried place, the lamp's flame leans toward the nearest hollow or door, and it gutters before a live ward or trap array is touched.
Flame Leans.not_run: out-of-fight ruin exploration rule, no combat record

Thaw the Ice.rule: Thawing Brazier (ln-thawing-brazier): fed with the holder's Fire qi, it thaws a hand's depth of old ice an hour and keeps a frozen hall's air breathable while it burns.
Thaw the Ice.not_run: out-of-fight ruin exploration rule, no combat record

Thaw.rule: Thawing Brazier (ln-thawing-brazier, authored d48): each Fire hit you land removes one Ice stack from you, at most 2 a pulse; each stack removed heals you 0.5 % of your maximum health and gives you one Fire buff stack for 5 s.

Will Not Fall.rule: Woodcutter's Pair, full set (2 pieces): once a fight, a hit that would drop you leaves you standing at 1 health with your body shield full; your next axe hit within 3 s heals you for half its damage.
Will Not Fall.approx: neither phu/mountain-cleave nor Lâm Dã Hạc's weapon techniques carry an axe tag in the engine, so the 3 s post-refusal lifesteal triggers on the next Physical hit landed (dtype: phys)

The Way Out.rule: The Digger's Kit, full set (3 pieces): the Lamp's flame also leans toward the way out in a fight. Once a fight, below a third of your health, you may leave at once; while you stand inside a foe's array, each of your seal hits breaks one of its nodes.
The Way Out.approx: no instant-flee action exists without an escape art and no diagram nodes exist on a foe in 1v1: dropping to <= 1/3 HP grants escape +100 for 300 s once per fight, and seal hits while foe.field_up >= 1 apply 1 Sundered (5 s, curse_duration_max) and delay the foe's longest-cooling art (which: longest, avoiding guarded-out Field stances) by 0.4 s

Never Had a Healer.rule: Bobtail Chief's Gear, full set (3 pieces): health your leech would waste on full health becomes a body shield instead, and the shield loses a tenth of itself each second; while that shield holds, your axe crits deal 25 % more damage.
Never Had a Healer.approx: no axe art tag exists on phu/mountain-cleave in the engine, so +25 % crit damage applies to Physical crits (dtype: phys, matching ln-robber-ring); overflow shield adds to the fighter's single body_bar once leech overflow occurs

Hot Hands.rule: Thaw-Girl's Fire, full set (2 pieces): your fist hits lay one Fire stack, and two on a foe that carries Ice stacks or is slowed.
